notes: road_classes_allowed uses the GDD-02 §3 hierarchy ids. Lane (goli) is physically closed to motor traffic by design; the promenade is pedestrian + cycles only. Fleet classes (bus, truck, CNG auto-rickshaw) are NPC/depot-operated in v1 and have no player buy price in prices.json v1.0, so price_ref is null and player_buyable is false — that gap is stated, not papered over (GDD-07 §8).
source_doc: docs/GDD-07-VEHICLES-AND-TRAFFIC.md (Unit P). Vehicle classes from docs/GDD-02-RUPSHA-CITY-DISTRICT1.md §3 road hierarchy. Buy prices are NOT duplicated here: every player-buyable entry points at data/prices.json `vehicles` via price_ref (GDD-03 §3.3 owns the numbers; if the two ever disagree, prices.json wins and this file is fixed). Speeds, capacities and fuel figures are v1 design values for the traffic model (GDD-07 §3), not physics claims — Chaos Vehicles tuning happens on the owner's PC.

vehicles.name: Bicycle
vehicles.notes: The honest starter vehicle (prices.json). No fuel cost, no licence, allowed in the goli lanes where motor traffic cannot go.

vehicles.name: Rickshaw (passenger)
vehicles.notes: First-class traffic, not a reskinned car (GDD-02 §3): own Zone Graph speed class. The owned rickshaw is the taxi-driver profession's starter work vehicle (prices.json rickshaw_own); passenger hire uses the same fare logic family as the taxi loop at rickshaw scale (GDD-07 §5).

vehicles.name: CNG auto-rickshaw (mishuk)
vehicles.notes: Fleet/NPC class in v1, based at the d1_transport stands and the d1_industry depot (GDD-02 §2). No player buy price exists in prices.json v1.0; adding one is a prices.json change, not a silent invention here. Hireable as a passenger like a taxi (GDD-07 §5).

vehicles.name: Motorbike
vehicles.notes: The District 1 workhorse (prices.json). Filters through collector/local congestion in the traffic model; still barred from goli lanes and the promenade.

vehicles.name: Car (small)
vehicles.notes: Mid-tier ownership goal (prices.json). Monthly fuel + upkeep is the prices.json living_costs.transport_own_car_fuel_upkeep band (mid 3,500 NCr).

vehicles.name: Car (premium)
vehicles.notes: Upper-tier marker (prices.json). Same road rights as car_small; the difference is price, upkeep band (upper 8,000 NCr/month) and status signalling in NPC reactions (GDD-01 derived class display, never a worth judgement).

vehicles.name: Taxi (licensed cab)
vehicles.notes: The fare-loop vehicle (GDD-06 §4.6, GDD-03 §8). Buy price and the 200 NCr/day rental both live in prices.json (vehicles.taxi_licensed, taxi_fares.cab_rental_ncr_per_day); rent before you buy is the designed on-ramp. Base d1_industry depot (GDD-02 §5 interior: Taxi/CNG depot office).

vehicles.name: Bus (city / intercity)
vehicles.notes: Route traffic only in v1: fixed loops between the d1_transport bus terminal and the district edge (Phase 8 travel gate direction). NPCs with a bus preference ride it as Commute scenery (GDD-06 §2). No player price in prices.json v1.0 — stated gap, see GDD-07 §8.

vehicles.name: Truck (goods / delivery)
vehicles.notes: Freight spine of the district: market godown deliveries run before 07:00 while the market spine bollards are down (GDD-02 §3), construction material deliveries feed Unit Q sites (GDD-08 §4). No player price in prices.json v1.0 — stated gap, see GDD-07 §8.
